title: Pick a reference video and add your character image in Seedance 2.0…
content: Pick a reference video and add your character image in Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Video to animate the character with the reference video’s motion and achieve more cinematic quality.
tips: Pick a reference video and add your character image in Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Video to animate the character with the reference video’s motion and achieve more cinematic quality.

es.content: Elige un video de referencia y añade la imagen de tu personaje en Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Video para animar al personaje con el movimiento del video de referencia y lograr una calidad más cinematográfica.

fr.content: Choisissez une vidéo de référence et ajoutez l'image de votre personnage dans Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Video pour animer le personnage avec le mouvement de la vidéo de référence et obtenir une qualité plus cinématographique.

ja.content: リファレンス動画を選び、Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Videoでキャラクター画像を追加して、リファレンス動画の動きでキャラクターをアニメーション化し、よりシネマティックな品質を実現します。

ko.content: 참조 비디오를 선택하고 Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Video에서 캐릭터 이미지를 추가하여 참조 비디오의 동작으로 캐릭터를 애니메이션화하고 더 높은 시네마틱 품질을 달성하세요.

pt.content: Escolha um vídeo de referência e adicione a imagem do seu personagem no Seedance 2.0 Character-to-Video para animar o personagem com o movimento do vídeo de referência e alcançar uma qualidade mais cinematográfica.

zh.content: 选择一个参考视频，并在Seedance 2.0的Character-to-Video中添加你的角色图像，以通过参考视频的动作为角色制作动画，从而实现更高的cinematic质量。
